records.source_statement: Sun and Moon conjoined and beholding ascendant are linked to an acquaintance of owner; source also gives either luminary beholding ascendant as similar.
preconditions: Together plus first-house aspect, or alternative single aspect.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This is a generic classification, not independently verified acquaintance.

records.source_statement: Sun or Moon in its proper house or in ascendant is said to make owner himself justly suspected.
preconditions: At least one luminary in own house or first under source's later variant.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This contradicts some other source relationship categories and is not proof.

records.source_statement: If Sun and Moon are not together but one beholds ascendant, source suggests someone once born or previously resident in the house.
preconditions: The lights are separated, one beholding first.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not conflate an acquaintance with a former resident or newborn.

records.source_statement: Sun or Moon in their own triplicity are said to indicate a thief familiar with the person who lost the goods.
preconditions: Luminary in own triplicity.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The author distinguishes this from a member of the owner's family.

records.source_statement: Sun or Moon having only a face dignity is said to identify a kinsman, not a household member.
preconditions: Only face rather than triplicity as key dignity.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Historical social-role inference not verified.

records.source_statement: Sun or Moon beholding ascendant but not the thief significator is said to mean alleged thief did not enter the house before taking.
preconditions: Moon/Sun aspect to first and nonaspect to thief significator.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Speculative reconstruction of an act.

records.source_statement: Thief's significator holding great essential dignities in ascendant is said to indicate kin or close acquaintance of querent.
preconditions: Thief significator dignified in first.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not evidence of familial involvement.

records.source_statement: Mars as thief significator in tenth is said to implicate querent himself or great negligence.
preconditions: Mars must represent thief and be in tenth.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Author offers two disjunct explanations; no verified negligence.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord in ascendant makes owner suspect the thief in source's allegation.
preconditions: Lord7 physically first.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Concerns suspicion rather than prosecution or proof.

records.source_statement: A new heading asks Whether it be the first fact the Thief hath committed.
preconditions: Scope is purported previous offences.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No external criminal record or repeat-offender rate.

records.source_statement: Sun and Moon both beholding the lord of Moon's house from an angle is said to mean the suspected thief acted more than once.
preconditions: Both luminaries and specific lord/angular condition.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: A historical prediction of past crime, not evidence of recidivism.

records.source_statement: The Part of Fortune (⊗) OR seventh-house lord free from misfortunes, OR Jupiter alone as thief significator, is said by Lilly to signify the alleged person's first offence.
preconditions: Original PDF395/printed361 prints the Part-of-Fortune glyph (circle and diagonal cross), not the indefinite word 'Fortune'. The three branches are alternatives.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Historical offender-description claim with no independently verified accuracy; do not interpret the symbol as a generic benefic planet.

records.source_statement: Mars separating from seventh lord is assigned to more than first offence.
preconditions: Mars separation from house7 lord.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not transpose separation direction.

records.source_statement: Saturn oriental is assigned to a previous offence in the same source list.
preconditions: Saturn in oriental condition.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No established age/time or observed crime.

records.source_statement: Mars as thief significator is said to indicate breaking in by violence.
preconditions: Mars assigned as thief in this paragraph.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Cannot infer actual forced entry.

records.source_statement: Venus in the thief-offence paragraph is associated with action under a pretext of love.
preconditions: Venus identified with relevant thief significator.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Gendered interpretation, not motive evidence.

records.source_statement: Mercury is associated with subtlety, flattery or deception in the same historical classification.
preconditions: Mercury relevant to thief's role.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No verified fraud or psychological trait.

records.source_statement: A new heading Of Theft by Astrologie, or LILLIES best experienced Rules introduces another authorial method set.
preconditions: Original subheading near lower PDF395.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Lilly's claim of experience is not independently evaluated.

records.source_statement: Many peregrine planets in angles are said to indicate multiple thieves.
preconditions: Peregrine status AND angular placement of multiple planets.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This is source count doctrine, not a measured number of offenders.

records.source_statement: Thief significator in fruitful or bicorporeal signs, or beholding many peregrines, is also said to imply many thieves.
preconditions: Specific source sign category or aspect to many peregrines.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Original bicorporeal printed sign list is subject to glyph/source collation.

records.source_statement: Fixed angles or Moon/thief significator in certain direct ascension/unfruitful signs is said to imply one thief.
preconditions: Fixed angles OR named Moon/significator sign groups.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The listed sign sets overlap source categories; do not silently normalize.

records.source_statement: A separate heading The Sex begins historical speculation about an alleged thief's male/female category.
preconditions: The question is presumed to concern a thief identified by significators.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not modern gender identification, legal evidence or an authentic identified suspect.

records.source_statement: A masculine hour lord, masculine seventh lord and masculine dispositor of the seventh are said to give a masculine outcome.
preconditions: All the listed planetary roles' sex class according to the historical system.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The text has a multi-body clause, not merely one masculine planet.

records.source_statement: Masculinity of both Moon's dispositor and the planet Moon applies to is another masculine branch.
preconditions: Dispositor of Moon and Moon's applying planet are both masculine.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Lunar applicative direction matters.

records.source_statement: Thief significator in the source-designated masculine half-heaven (first, twelfth, eleventh, seventh, sixth or fifth), together with oriental status, is offered as a masculine indicator.
preconditions: Source describes named houses and oriental status.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No real person category can be inferred from chart alone.

records.source_statement: Lilly says the contrary configurations to those stated are feminine.
preconditions: Evaluate the prior planetary/house/temporal conditions in reverse.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source does not provide a calibrated third category or measurement error.

records.source_statement: A new heading Age offers several nonidentical ways to guess an alleged thief's years.
preconditions: Historical thief-significator chosen.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not treat multiple alternative formulas as independent people.

records.source_statement: Saturn as significator indicates old or aged person in author's age taxonomy.
preconditions: Saturn is actual thief significator.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Different from planet Saturn orientality affecting age separately.

records.source_statement: Jupiter, Mars or Sun as thief significator is used to assign an adult/man rather than very old or youth.
preconditions: The named planet is chief significator.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Does not give exact years.

records.source_statement: Mercury or Venus as significator indicates less aged person.
preconditions: Mercury or Venus holds the source role.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: An historical classifier with no validation.

records.source_statement: Moon in first quarter is assigned youth, second quarter older, third quarter more aged, final quarter greatest years.
preconditions: Moon phase/quarter is the selected age significator.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Author's gradual stages, not exact date-of-birth decoding.

records.source_statement: An oriental Moon or relevant planet indicates younger; occidental position indicates more aged.
preconditions: The relevant thief significator's oriental/occidental status is known.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This may overlap/tension with planetary strength rules elsewhere.

records.source_statement: Lilly offers counting five years for every house the significator is distant from ascendant.
preconditions: Count the relevant houses from first, not merely any house index.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Historically suggested arithmetic, not tested numeric age estimator.

records.source_statement: Another age method counts two years per degree descending in the seventh house.
preconditions: A selected degree count in seventh house is available.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Ambiguous degree anchor: no false precision or automatic generalization.

records.source_statement: Lilly offers the age of the planet to which Moon applies, OR the age of the thief's significator, as alternative age-estimation testimonies.
preconditions: A Moon-applying planet OR the separately chosen thief significator may provide the age testimony; neither is necessarily the other.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Two textual alternatives, not a requirement that the Moon apply to the thief's significator; historical age taxonomy has no verified demographic accuracy.

records.source_statement: The author also takes elapsed days from a reference day of the month to the question day, multiplying each day by two years.
preconditions: One exact earlier day and current question day defined.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This is authorial historical method; reference day choice ambiguous.

records.source_statement: After giving several different ways to assign an alleged person's age, Lilly says to consider most of these ways and 'pitch upon the greatest number'; the source does not explicitly prescribe choosing the greatest amount of agreeing testimony.
preconditions: Multiple previously listed age-number methods have been considered.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Literal 'greatest number' may mean the numerically highest age result; majority-vote/most-supported age interpretation is not textually stated. No selection may be retrospectively tuned to actual ages.

records.source_statement: A heading Forme and Stature introduces body-form guesses.
preconditions: Source thief significator, its sign and orientation.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not an actual body identification, profile or discriminatory classifier.

records.source_statement: A significator with much orientality in Leo, Scorpio or Sagittarius is associated with a large/tall proportion.
preconditions: The named Leo/Scorpio/Sagittarius signs and significant orientality.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Original glyphs should be preserved; no biometric evidence.

records.source_statement: Lilly assigns a smaller bodily proportion if the significator has much occidentality, OR if it is in Cancer, Scorpio or Pisces: distinct alternative tests.
preconditions: Either significant occidentality OR significator in one of Cancer/Scorpio/Pisces; the printed grammar says OR, not AND.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The earlier producer incorrectly required both occidentality and a water sign. Scorpio also appears in the large-proportion list under a different conjunction; no empirical measurement is established.

records.source_statement: A significator in Aries, Taurus or Leo is said to make the upper part of the thief's body thick/strong.
preconditions: Source chosen signifier in one of three signs.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Under historical form/stature section only.

records.source_statement: Sagittarius, Gemini or Scorpio is said to make lower body parts more pronounced.
preconditions: The relevant significator in one of three source signs.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Literal medical anatomy not implied; source taxonomy only.

records.source_statement: A new heading Fat begins a detailed bodily-proportion classification.
preconditions: Relevant planet physically representing the alleged thief.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Physical characteristics based on horoscope are not verified.

records.source_statement: Large latitude from ecliptic, retrogradation or first station are offered as alternative indications of a fat person.
preconditions: A planet significator with one of the stated astronomical conditions.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Original also lists specific sign portions; do not omit them.

records.source_statement: Early portions of Aries/Taurus/Leo or last portions of Gemini/Scorpio/Sagittarius are given as additional fatness signs.
preconditions: The thief significator in precisely the stated first/last sign regions.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not necessarily a generic sign-wide condition.

records.source_statement: Moon in Cancer or Pisces is described as inclining to tallness in the fatness discussion.
preconditions: Moon placed in either sign.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: A different body attribute from fatness.

records.source_statement: Moon in Libra, Virgo or Aquarius is said to give flesh and good proportion.
preconditions: Moon in named signs.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not an objective healthy-body classification.

records.source_statement: The heading Leane opens contrary body-form rules.
preconditions: Relevant thief significator is already selected.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source notion of leanness is historical.

records.source_statement: Small latitude, direct motion or second station of relevant significator are taken as indicators of a lean body.
preconditions: One of three original planetary conditions.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Later author adds degree/sign conditions.

records.source_statement: Beginning portions of Gemini, Scorpio or Sagittarius, or extremity of planetary eccentricity, are offered as additional leanness indicators.
preconditions: Named sign portion or orbital condition.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The list differs from previous last-portion 'fat' category.

records.source_statement: Sun beholding thief significator is separately said to give handsome shape and some fatness, despite appearing beneath the Lean heading.
preconditions: The Sun actually beholds the relevant significator.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not silently treat Sun as a leanness marker.

records.source_statement: Moon beholding significator is said to give temperance and moistness.
preconditions: A lunar aspect to relevant planet.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Historical humoral body-language, not medical fact.

records.source_statement: The heading The Thiefs strength introduces separate mobility/strength claims.
preconditions: The source selected planet continues to represent alleged thief.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No corroborated physical capability inference.

records.source_statement: Thief significator in SOUTH celestial latitude is said to indicate nimble activity.
preconditions: South latitude of specific planet.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source maps direction of latitude to gait, not empirical.

records.source_statement: Significator in NORTH latitude is said to indicate slow motion.
preconditions: North latitude of same selected planet.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not necessarily weaker strength; source labels slow.

records.source_statement: Planet in first station is said to give stronger bodies.
preconditions: Actual first station rather than second.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Can conflict with source fat and age statements; separate domain.

records.source_statement: Planet crossing from one zodiac sign to another is said to indicate weak/feeble bodies.
preconditions: At sign boundary/ingress under author's interpretation.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not generic all sign transitions.

records.source_statement: The heading Where the Knave is begins tracking whether a presumed fugitive keeps moving.
preconditions: The question presupposes an offender.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not a real-person tracking capability.

records.source_statement: Under 'Where the Knave is', the author uses plural 'the Significators' passing from one zodiac sign into another as one alternative assertion of changing lodgings; which/how many must cross is unspecified.
preconditions: Printed PDF397/363: 'if the Significators be going out of one Signe into another' (plural).
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not force a singular thief significator or assert ALL/ANY quantification absent from the sentence.

records.source_statement: Thief significator leaving combustion or the rays of Sun is another indication he moves.
preconditions: Leaving, not merely under Sun's rays.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Direction of exit matters.

records.source_statement: Thief's dispositor separating from ascendant lord and applying to a planet in sixth, eighth or twelfth is said to indicate flight or change of lodging.
preconditions: Specific prior separation and future application into one of the three named houses.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not the same as an unconnected 6/8/12 planet.

records.source_statement: Thief and missing-good significators not occupying one quarter of heaven are said to imply greater distance or flight.
preconditions: Two source signifiers occupy different quarters.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This is a categorical distance rule, not GPS.

records.source_statement: Thief significator or missing-thing significator applying to third/ninth lord, or themselves located in those houses, are further source-distance indications.
preconditions: A directed application or placement in third/ninth.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not count four alternatives as four crimes.

records.source_statement: The heading He remaines introduces a negative flight/continued-presence reading.
preconditions: A source-specific alternative to change/flight.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The consequent may be elided in the printed sentence.

records.source_statement: Under 'He remaines', the ascendant lord is joined to a planet in a cadent house; the original additionally says 'and behold the ascendant', without unambiguously identifying which planetary subject beholds it.
preconditions: First-house lord joined to a planet in a cadent house; a beholding of the ascendant is also mentioned.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The aspect actor cannot be assigned uniquely to the cadent planet or first lord from the printed grammar. Consequent comes from the section heading, not an explicit following sentence.

records.source_statement: A printed unnumbered heading Who the Thiefe is opens possible household familiarity rules.
preconditions: Begins above the separate heading A stranger and the direction table.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: These are speculative claims, not identification of a real offender.

records.source_statement: Sun and Moon both beholding ascendant together are read as implying a familiar of the house.
preconditions: Both luminaries aspect the ascendant at one time.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not infer a real household culprit.

records.source_statement: Ascendant lord joined to seventh lord in ascendant is another alleged indication of a familiar.
preconditions: Both designated lords conjoined in first.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The same configuration is used for different outcomes in other chapters; scope is local.

records.source_statement: Lilly says Sun and Moon in Leo or Cancer, or in first or in house of ascendant lord and beholding it, may signify someone well known but not belonging to the family.
preconditions: The source supplies multiple alternatives around the luminaries and signs.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Compound syntax is ambiguous; preserve alternatives rather than a unique psychological identity.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord in eighth or twelfth is listed among conditions for a person known but not of the family.
preconditions: Specific seventh-house ruler in eighth or twelfth.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No evidence of real friendship or criminal conduct.

records.source_statement: Sun or Moon in exaltation appears among indications of an acquaintance who is not a family member.
preconditions: Relevant luminary in own exaltation.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Distinguish from the later 'terms or faces' rule.

records.source_statement: Luminaries in their terms or faces are said to indicate one known to the household but not of the family.
preconditions: Sun or Moon has term/face dignity as source requires.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Don't equate 'household' and 'family'.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord situated in seventh is separately claimed to indicate someone of the household.
preconditions: The alleged thief's seventh lord occupies its own seventh house.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This is authorial historical testimony only.

records.source_statement: The heading A stranger introduces conditions offered for identifying an outsider rather than family or household person.
preconditions: Comes after the familiar/household alternatives.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Neither positive nor negative results establish a suspect.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord in the third or ninth counted from his own house is said to indicate a stranger.
preconditions: Turned-house third/ninth from seventh, rather than necessarily the radical third/ninth.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The printed 'from his house' requires interpreting turning correctly; preserve ambiguity.

records.source_statement: If first lord and seventh lord do not belong to one triplicity, Lilly gives another outsider indication.
preconditions: The two planetary significators are not of one triplicity.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source's definition of lord 'of one triplicity' is not independently specified.

records.source_statement: When a person is deemed domestic, Lilly offers a planetary role list of supposed household relations.
preconditions: Domestic conclusion is already established in the source's chart method.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not a way to diagnose a real person's relationship or guilt.

records.source_statement: Sun is associated with father or master of household in the printed domestic-person list.
preconditions: Sun occupies the specified role in this secondary classification.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Historical household stereotype.

records.source_statement: Moon is associated with mother or mistress in the domestic-person list.
preconditions: Moon relevant to the role.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not a real accusation against any mother.

records.source_statement: Venus is associated with a wife or woman.
preconditions: Venus relevant.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not a verified woman or spouse.

records.source_statement: Saturn is described as a servant or a stranger lying there by chance.
preconditions: Saturn relevant to domestic category.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The source itself gives two disjunct possibilities.

records.source_statement: Mars is associated with a son, brother or kinsman.
preconditions: Mars relevant to domestic category.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Keep each role alternative.

records.source_statement: Mercury is associated with a youth, familiar or friend.
preconditions: Mercury relevant.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No biographical knowledge inferred.

records.source_statement: The printed heading Whither is the Thief gone, or Fugitive begins a location-direction inquiry.
preconditions: After domestic/stranger classification.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source directions are hypotheses, not actual tracking.

records.source_statement: Lilly calls ascendant, or a planet significant within it, East as primary anchor for the listed house directions.
preconditions: Ascendant or selected significator in first house.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The same subsection says its table provides fuller quarters.

records.source_statement: One 12-house direction table assigns first east, seventh west, fourth north and tenth south, with intermediary quarters for other houses.
preconditions: Use the exact house indicated by the fugitive significator.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Twelve table rows appear in PRINTED_DIRECTION_TABLES.json and original PDF398 image. Printed table isn't independently validated.

records.source_statement: Printed heading The Signes introduces two parallel tables of zodiac sign to direction.
preconditions: The relevant zodiac sign must be identified.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The printed pair shows small differences and the margin says use what seems true; keep both.

records.source_statement: First printed table assigns Aries east, Cancer full north, Libra full west, Capricorn full south and intercardinal directions to eight remaining signs.
preconditions: Select the relevant sign; use the original table's direction, not interpolated compass bearing.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Twelve rows in PRINTED_DIRECTION_TABLES.json; source page is authority.

records.source_statement: Second printed table uses zodiac glyphs and slightly different intercardinal descriptions including Leo northeast-by-east and Taurus southeast-by-south.
preconditions: Use the second printed table as a DISTINCT competing method.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Do not silently choose whichever table fits an observed location.

records.source_statement: Printed margin acknowledges the small differences between two tables and advises readers to use whichever they find most true.
preconditions: Both original zodiac direction tables must be compared.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This is explicit flexible selection with empirical overfitting risk; not a consensus direction.

records.source_statement: A printed heading The flight of the Thiefe introduces flight-speed interpretation.
preconditions: Apply only to alleged fugitive's selected significator.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not geographic tracking of a real offender.

records.source_statement: The alleged thief is described as fleeing swiftly when his significator moves swiftly.
preconditions: Thief significator swift in motion.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Requires relative planetary motion from an actual historic chart, not just sign.

records.source_statement: Joining to other planets swift in motion is another claimed flight-speed condition.
preconditions: Thief significator joined to a swift-moving planet.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Separate from sign-based modality.

records.source_statement: Significator in movable signs or signs of short ascensions is likewise associated with swift flight.
preconditions: The relevant significator's sign must be movable or short-ascension.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The two sign categories are alternative criteria and their location/latitude convention is unverified.

records.source_statement: A distinct heading His flight is uncertaine introduces a separate alternative.
preconditions: Distinguished from swift and slow conditions.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: A class of uncertain prediction, not an observed evasive manoeuvre.

records.source_statement: Significators in their second station are said to imply uncertain movement.
preconditions: Second, NOT first station.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: House and station conditions shouldn't be conflated.

records.source_statement: Joined to stationary planets in angles or succedents also yields an uncertain flight claim.
preconditions: A stationary planet joined and placed angular/succedent.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Don't reduce to any stationary planet anywhere.

records.source_statement: A heading He makes slow haste introduces a slower category.
preconditions: Contrast with movable/short-ascension swift flight.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No measured travel speed.

records.source_statement: Slow significator or conjunction to slow planets is said to make the alleged thief move slowly.
preconditions: The thief's planet is slow, or joined to a slow-moving planet.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This may overlap second-station uncertainty; preserve labels.

records.source_statement: Significator in a fixed sign or sign of long ascensions is said to mean slow flight.
preconditions: Fixed modality or long-ascension sign.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No modern timing calibration.

records.source_statement: A new heading He shall be taken introduces a series of alternative alleged capture configurations.
preconditions: These are historical source rules, not criminal-investigative evidence.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source sentence runs into next page for negative capture exceptions.

records.source_statement: First-house lord in seventh, or conjoined with seventh-house lord, is given as an alleged capture condition.
preconditions: Specific first-to-seventh physical placement or conjunction.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Does not demonstrate apprehension.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord in first or joined to first lord is another capture indication.
preconditions: Seventh-house significator in first or conjoined with first.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Treat as alternative to first lord in seventh.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord joined to a retrograde planet is another claimed capture condition; this is separate from the seventh lord being in the first or joined to the first lord.
preconditions: Printed PDF399/365: 'or a Retrograde Planet' follows 'joyned to the Lord of the first'; whether coordinated as an object of the seventh lord's joining is grammatically implied, not independently verified.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Historical allegation only. Do not require first-house placement in the retrograde branch without the source saying so.

records.source_statement: Moon separating from the lord of the seventh and moving to conjunction with the lord of the first is offered as a capture testimony.
preconditions: Original PDF399/365: 'or if the Moon separate from the lord of the seventh, to the conjunction of the lord of the first'.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Moon-in-seventh square Mars belongs to a DIFFERENT additional capture list on PDF400; it was wrongly copied here in the earlier producer draft.

records.source_statement: Moon separating from the conjunction of the lord of the first toward the lord of the seventh is a separate historical capture indication.
preconditions: Original PDF399/365: 'or from the conjunction of the lord of the first to the lord of the seventh'; the exact aspect of its final contact with seventh lord is not specified.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The old draft erroneously imported a Moon/Saturn/Mercury/Sun square condition from next-page PDF400.

records.source_statement: Sun and Moon in conjunction with the lord of the seventh, or in a variant reading beholding him, are cited as historical capture indications.
preconditions: Original PDF399/365: 'or if Sun and Moon be in conjunction with the lord of the seventh, some say, if they behold him'.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The source's 'some say' offers a qualified alternate aspect criterion; keep source uncertainty. Moon in sixth/eighth/twelfth is on PDF400, not this page.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord going to conjunction with the Sun, described as combustion, is presented as a historical capture condition.
preconditions: Original PDF399/365: 'or if the lord of the seventh be going to conjunction, viz. Combustion'.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The prior Saturn/Mercury progression is on PDF400. The source does not specify exact orbs/timing.

records.source_statement: Lilly adds an obscure condition of the ascendant lord being in conjunction in the ascendant, tenth or seventh, OR an unfortunate planet in the seventh, as further capture indicators.
preconditions: Original PDF399/365: 'or if the lord of the ascendant be in conjunction in the ascendant, tenth or seventh, or an infortunate Planet in the seventh'.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The conjunction's other party is unspecified in this printed phrase; do not invent one. Moon-eighth/Mars-second is separately on PDF400.

records.source_statement: The heading Not taken begins an explicit escape/noncapture exception section.
preconditions: Below page turn from captured list.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Must not conflate with every Fortune contact being favorable to capture.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord aspecting a Fortune is offered as a noncapture testimony.
preconditions: Seventh lord with a benefic configuration.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The following qualifying branches describe escape aided by others.

records.source_statement: If the Fortune involved is Jupiter or Venus in eleventh, escape is attributed to friends.
preconditions: Jupiter/Venus and eleventh-house location must be checked.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source explanation is hypothetical; no actual aiding friend established.

records.source_statement: If Jupiter/Venus occupies third instead, the author attributes escape to strangers.
preconditions: Same Fortune in third, not eleventh.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Distinct from the friend assistance condition.

records.source_statement: Separate printed heading The Goods restored begins restitution rather than offender capture rules.
preconditions: Original PDF400 upper.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No empirical recovered goods case.

records.source_statement: Lord of first OR second in conjunction with eighth lord is a claimed return-of-goods condition.
preconditions: One specified owner/goods lord joined to eighth lord.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Contradicts some earlier eighth-related no-recovery readings, preserved separately.

records.source_statement: Strong reception involving these goods or owner rulers is also described as hopeful for restoration.
preconditions: Specific house lords/ruler reception.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Reception is not a sufficient empirical probability.

records.source_statement: Second-house lord departing from combustion is said to support recovery.
preconditions: Second lord LEAVING combustion, not combust.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: This reverses the negative combust-source rule.

records.source_statement: Sun OR Moon in first or tenth is an additional good-restitution claim.
preconditions: The source lists the luminaries and houses as alternatives.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Does not require Sun and Moon conjunct; exact coordination ambiguous.

records.source_statement: When the recovery luminaries are strong, the author says most of the goods may return.
preconditions: Strong luminaries and favorable prior restitution condition.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source says ‘the most part’, not all.

records.source_statement: When the luminaries are weak, less of the lost goods is said to return.
preconditions: Weak significators/lights.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Historically suggested fractional outcome, not measured.

records.source_statement: Sun and Moon in some aspect, especially when angular, give hope of restitution.
preconditions: The two lights aspect one another under described conditions.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source lists first/seventh/eighth lords separately; keep scope ambiguous.

records.source_statement: Lord of seventh or eighth is listed as additional testimony in goods-restored passage.
preconditions: A named relation involving seventh/eighth lords, incomplete in printed fragment.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No invented missing predicate.
PDF400/366 has an elliptical trailing clause 'or the lord of the seventh or eighth'; do not construe either ruler alone as a fully stated sufficient condition.

records.source_statement: Heading No Restitution opens adverse rules for loss.
preconditions: Keep it separate from capture and return claims.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source statements are not verified case studies.

records.source_statement: Second-house lord combust is said to indicate no restitution.
preconditions: Second lord within combustion condition.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Opposes ‘departing from combustion’ success passage above.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord joined by conjunction with eighth lord is an adverse restitution condition.
preconditions: Lord7 joined to lord8.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not a generic seventh-house malefic.

records.source_statement: Second lord not beholding the first house or its lord is listed as no-restoration testimony.
preconditions: No aspect from goods' lord to first cusp or ruler.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Different from earlier positive reception.

records.source_statement: Sun and Moon not mutually aspecting are listed among no restitution signs.
preconditions: Absence of Sun–Moon aspect.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not equivalent to both being below the earth.

records.source_statement: Part of Fortune and/or both lights below earth are listed as adverse; syntactic grouping is uncertain.
preconditions: Check glyph and scope of 'when both under earth'.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Keep any ambiguity, don't invent which two are involved.

records.source_statement: The heading Other Rules that the Thiefe shall be taken opens an additional compact list.
preconditions: Occurs immediately before Chapter LI divider.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: List should be transcribed as source data, not police guidance.

records.source_statement: Moon in seventh applying to eighth lord is an alleged capture condition.
preconditions: Moon in seventh, applying to eighth ruler.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Application to l8 specifically, not a generic aspect.

records.source_statement: First lord situated in ascendant is separately on the capture list.
preconditions: First-house ruler in first.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not evidence of criminal guilt.

records.source_statement: Moon in seventh applying by square to Mars is included in this separate additional capture list.
preconditions: Moon in seventh, directed square to Mars.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: An authorial repetition of p399, not new observed support.

records.source_statement: Moon separating from square Saturn or Mercury then applying to square Sun is included in this separate additional capture list.
preconditions: Ordered past-to-future square configurations.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Source symbols may be hard to distinguish; original image prevails.

records.source_statement: Moon in sixth, eighth or twelfth is included in this separate additional capture list.
preconditions: Moon in one of three houses.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Not a second observed capture outcome.

records.source_statement: Seventh lord in first is included as an extra capture condition.
preconditions: Thief's significator in first.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: A source repetition from p399.

records.source_statement: Moon separating from Saturn conjunction and applying to Mercury square is one of the printed combinations.
preconditions: Directed lunar separation/application.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: Adjacent first-house ruler/seventh-house ruler placement may also be required.

records.source_statement: The printed final capture-list clause places the Moon in the eighth house IN OPPOSITION (☍) to Mars in the second house; it does not prescribe conjunction.
preconditions: Original PDF400/printed366 at the last line above Chapter LI: Moon in eighth, opposition (☍) to Mars in second. This is a historical author's statement only.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: The prior producer misread the opposition ☍ glyph as conjunction ☌ and inferred a false geometry conflict. No observed outcome or independent astrological validity follows.

records.source_statement: Horizontal divider closes Chapter L on original PDF400 / printed366; Chapter LI Of Battell, Warre, or other Contentions begins below it.
preconditions: All above-divider Chapter L text included; below divider excluded.
exceptions_and_evidence_limits: No case/evidence drawn from Chapter LI.
